text.en:
Except for the foregoing amendments, all other provisions of EO
No. 54 shall remain unchanged.

All executive orders, rules and regulations, and other issuances
or parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Order are hereby revoked, amended
or modified accordingly.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 28th day of August
our Lord, Two Thousand Nineteen.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
